video_title: Hornets at Celtics: Christian Anderson Jr. Postgame Media Availability | 10/14/2026

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on his preseason preparation and team integration
quotes.excerpt: I think preparing like practice, trying to practice like how we're going to play, that helped me.
quotes.quote: I think preparing like practice, trying to practice like how we're going to play, that helped me just come on the court and kind of be ready. But also our teammates, coaches keeping me ready, watching film and my teammates making it as easy as possible for me to kind of just fit into the game plan seamlessly.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr. credits his seamless transition to the Hornets to consistent practice habits and film study. He says his teammates are making it as easy as possible to fit into the game plan.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on his goals for his rookie preseason
quotes.excerpt: Just to be a guy who contributes offensively or defensively, trying to play hard every single second.
quotes.quote: Just to be a guy who contributes offensively or defensively, trying to play hard every single second of the game and try to make an impact, make it as hard as we can for the other team.
quotes.social_post: Rookie Christian Anderson Jr. on his preseason goals. He wants to be a guy who contributes on both ends of the floor and tries to play hard every single second of the game.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on his specific role and defensive responsibilities
quotes.excerpt: Pressuring the ball, being disruptive on defense, not trying to give guys easy looks, communicating.
quotes.quote: Pressuring the ball, being disruptive on defense, not trying to give guys easy looks, communicating, and also just somebody who can be trusted with the ball, make plays.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr. outlines his defensive focus for the Hornets. He is looking to be disruptive by pressuring the ball and not giving guys easy looks while being someone who can be trusted to make plays.
